$comment: The source of sf-confirm's element plumbing (core/js/element-manifest.js); standard simai.smart-component 1.3.8, vocabulary 1.1.5. The plain question of block confirm; sf-confirm-change is the same surface over values (src/smart/helpers/confirm-surface.js).

question.summary: The question, said in place: what will happen, as a sentence («Удалить файл «Отчёт.pdf»?»). It names the group; without one the group is named «Подтверждение».

state.summary: open: the answers are offered. pending: an answer is on its way (set by a press). accepted, declined, expired: only the outcome is shown.

expires-at.summary: ISO 8601. Past it an open question reads as expired and says so once with sf-confirm-expired.

confirm-id.summary: The host's name for the question (the row, the record), carried back in every event.

disabled.summary: The answers are shown and cannot be pressed (a send is in flight elsewhere).

destructive.summary: The acceptance destroys something (a delete): the accepting answer wears the error status.

appearance.summary: inline: the question and its answers in the flow of a row, no frame of their own. card: in a framed card with its own inset.

accept-text.summary: The accepting answer; empty is Confirm in the page's language.

decline-text.summary: The declining answer; empty is Cancel in the page's language.

answer.summary: The person answered (vocabulary answer). Cancel it to keep the question open.

expired.summary: An open question passed expires-at; said once per time.

open.summary: Puts the question again; asked by an assembly it answers {accepted, reason, value} when the person answers or the time runs out.

answer.summary: Answer as the person would: accepted true confirms, false declines. Refused unknown, closed, disabled or prevented.

cancel.summary: The declining answer; data-sf-action="<id>.cancel". Escape inside an open question is the same answer.

default.$comment: The Lit template in JavaScript, the migration form of §5.2 (§16).

accessibility.x-keys: Enter and Space press the focused answer (two native buttons); Escape inside an open question declines, as the declining answer does

x-summary: A question put to a person in place -- a delete asked in its row, a member removed, a view reset: what will happen, two answers, a pending state while the answer is applied, the outcome, and an optional time it runs out. Applies nothing; a press is an event.

x-source.from: the in-place confirms of ui-pro chat-window (files, members), chat-message (delete) and view-properties (reset view); duplication audit 2026-11-03 A-5

x-decisions: block confirm (owner decision 2026-11-03, component sets, point 13; duplication audit 2026-11-03 A-5): sf-confirm is the block's main member, the plain question; sf-confirm-change is its variant over values. Both are one confirm surface, src/smart/helpers/confirm-surface.js (state, expiry, pending, the two answers, the ask of an assembly) with one footer template; sf-modal's confirm() stays the modal case.

a11y-role: group named by the question (aria-labelledby on its paragraph), else by runtime.question-label. An in-place question is not a heading: it sits in a row of a list or a panel, where a heading would break the outline.

Escape: an open question answered from inside by Escape declines, as the chat's in-place delete did (chat-message 1.2.0); the key goes no further (a surrounding drawer or modal does not close on the same press).
destructive: the accepting answer wears status error (sf-button), the delete case; both answers stay outlined and of equal weight otherwise.
appearance: inline (default) has no frame -- a row's question in the row's own surface; card frames it with --sf-confirm-inset, --sf-confirm-radius and --sf-confirm-background-color.
words: lang/ru.json and lang/en.json; the answers default to Подтвердить and Отмена.

$comment: The question draws its two answers as sf-button and the outcome's glyph as
sf-icon; a tag it renders is a tag it fetches.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-confirm wherever a person must say yes or no in place before something happens -- a delete in its row, a member removed, a setting reset. For values shown as they were and as they will be use sf-confirm-change; for a question that must block the page use sf-modal confirm().
do_not: Do not apply anything in the element; answer the event and set state
Do not leave it pending: set accepted, declined, or open again
Do not pass markup in the question; it is text

accessibility.focus: A group named by its question. The status line is a polite live region, present before it speaks; when a press takes the answers away, focus moves to it instead of falling to the page, and back to the first answer when the host cancels. Escape inside an open question declines.
